list: GTA VI trophies — Leonida Platinum Atlas

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands when the other 54 are done. Work the roadmap in order — story first, stranger strands before the finale, then the long grinds (stunts, cards, WAiNK) last. Nothing here needs a second playthrough if you flag the 15 missables as you go.
steps: Finish all story chapters
Clear every stranger strand before the finale
Sweep the collectible and activity grinds

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the Gone Fishing mission. It is an early story mission — follow the objective markers, and take your time with the fishing tutorial: the casting mini-game is the only part that can slow you down.
steps: Play the story until Gone Fishing unlocks
Follow the on-screen fishing prompts

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order and there is no way to skip ahead, so just play the missions. Check the roadmap tab for where Chapter 1 ends, so you do not start stranger strands you meant to save for later.
steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission in order

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapters: play the missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. If a mission fails, it restarts from the last checkpoint, so no progress is lost.
steps: Play every Chapter 2 mission in order

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. By now the map is mostly open — use the travel time between missions to tick off WAiNK spots and vehicles for the exploration trophies, instead of making separate trips later.
steps: Play every Chapter 3 mission in order

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Before the finale, pause and clear the stranger strands — several of them lock once the story ends. The roadmap tab lists the strands to finish first.
steps: Play every Chapter 4 mission in order
Clear stranger strands before the final mission

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The finale turns on the choice you make in the last scene — the trophy is for finishing it, so save in a separate slot before the final choice and keep that backup in case you want the other ending later.
steps: Save in a separate slot before the final choice
Complete the final mission
trophies.missableNote: The final mission is a one-time story beat. Save in a separate slot before the last choice; if the ending does not land the way you wanted, reload rather than starting over.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Drive to the marker, follow the crew's lead, and keep your health up in the shootout at the end — cover is plentiful, so do not stand in the open.
steps: Drive to the Breakfast Run marker
Clear the shootout using cover

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are linear: follow the plan, and use cover during the vault sequence. If you fail, the mission restarts from the last checkpoint.
steps: Follow the heist plan to the vault
Hold cover during the escape

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. It is a story mission with a driving section first and a close-quarters section after — take the driving line the game marks, then move slowly through the interior.
steps: Drive the marked route to the mission
Clear the interior section

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. The set piece does most of the work — stay on the objective marker and let the scene play. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
steps: Follow the Headliners objectives to the end

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Airport missions mean tight sightlines and fast response — move between cover, and keep a fast car ready for the exit.
steps: Clear the takedown objectives inside VCIA
Escape via the marked exit

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. It is a longer combat mission — conserve ammo in the early waves, and use the heavy weapons the mission hands you for the final push.
steps: Work through the operation's waves
Use the mission-supplied heavy weapons for the finale

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. This is the long grind: every story mission, stranger strand, stunt, collectible set and activity counts. Tick off the other 54 first — the last few percent are almost always the stunts, the WAiNK spots and the card sets.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
Check the in-game stats for the remaining percentage points
Finish stunts, cards and WAiNK last

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, near-misses and airtime all count — the fastest route is a loop of stunt jumps with a fast bike, resetting after each landing. Chip away at it between missions; the tracker counts every stunt.
steps: Find a stunt-jump loop with a fast bike
Chain jumps, near-misses and airtime between missions

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — one race, one fishing challenge, one arcade game, one shooting-range round, one bowling game and so on. The activity filter shows every activity trophy; sample each one and tick it as you go.
steps: Open the activity filter to see every activity
Try one of each type

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and time — take the slow, aimed shots first to bank accuracy, then push the pace. The pistol challenges are the easiest golds; save the rifle timed rounds for last, and replay a single challenge as many times as you need.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list
Gold the pistol challenges first
Replay the rifle timed rounds until the gold threshold clears

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Each location has its own course — learn the gates on a practice run, then race for the win. The drone handles like a boat in the air, so brake early into turns.
steps: Practice each course once to learn the gates
Win the race at every location

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races count per event, not per win — work through the race list and tick each one off. Mix road, off-road and water races; the easiest wins are the short sprint events.
steps: Open the race list and pick unraced events
Win 20 different races

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing mini-game: wait for the strong pull, reel in bursts, and let the line slack when the fish runs. Cal's challenge unlocks after you meet him — challenge him whenever he appears at a fishing spot.
steps: Meet Cal and unlock his fishing challenge
Reel in bursts and slack the line when the fish runs

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the shortest game, learn its one mechanic, and play it through to the end. Arcades are marked on the map once you discover them.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet
Play one game through to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger strands end when their final mission is done, and the strand locks after that — finish Andy's strand before the story finale. Andy's missions are marked stranger in the checklist.
steps: Play Andy's strand missions in order
Finish the final mission before the story finale
trophies.missableNote: Andy's strand locks once its final mission is done. Finish it before the last story chapter; after the finale the strand is gone.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Like every stranger strand, Kenton's ends at its final mission — clear it before the finale, while the strand is still open.
steps: Play Kenton's strand missions in order
Finish the final mission before the story finale
trophies.missableNote: Kenton's strand locks once its final mission is done. Finish it before the last story chapter; after the finale the strand is gone.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a riding strand — the final mission is a long ride, so keep a fast bike ready and follow the route markers.
steps: Play Billy's strand missions in order
Finish the final mission before the story finale
trophies.missableNote: Billy's strand locks once its final mission is done. Finish it before the last story chapter; after the finale the strand is gone.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strands unlock as you explore — talk to every stranger marker you pass. Eight strands is the count, not all of them, so you can skip the ones you dislike.
steps: Talk to stranger markers as you explore
Complete any 8 full strands

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a supply-run strand — the final mission is a timed delivery, so plan the route before you start the clock.
steps: Play Randy's strand missions in order
Finish the final mission before the story finale
trophies.missableNote: Randy's strand locks once its final mission is done. Finish it before the last story chapter; after the finale the strand is gone.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with a set piece — follow the markers and let the scene play; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
steps: Play Tyrone's strand missions in order
Finish the final mission before the story finale
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone's strand locks once its final mission is done. Finish it before the last story chapter; after the finale the strand is gone.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet viewpoints — the map marks them once you find one, and the count is in the pause menu. Work through them region by region; the mountain and beach spots are the easiest to miss.
steps: Find a meditation spot and meditate
Sweep every region for the remaining spots

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts are one-off: track the animal from the clues he gives, approach downwind, and take the shot cleanly. If the animal spooks, leave the area and come back — it respawns.
steps: Take Bret's hunt and follow the clues
Approach downwind and take a clean shot

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — shops, interiors and landmarks. A set needs every card in it, so sweep one region at a time and tick sets off as they complete.
steps: Pick one card set and sweep its region
Use the source map for the last few cards in each set
Complete any 3 sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are the photo and scan points scattered across the state — the counter ticks each time you use one. Fold it into your travel: hit every WAiNK point you pass instead of making a separate trip.
steps: Use every WAiNK point you pass while travelling
Sweep the map for the last ones

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small objectives layered over the open world — stunt, combat, driving and exploration. They stack naturally if you vary what you do; check the challenges tab for the ones nearest completion.
steps: Vary what you do — stunt, combat, driving, exploration
Check the challenges tab for near-complete ones

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need your partner beside you when the wanted level hits 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Do it in the countryside, where helicopters are slower to arrive.
steps: Bring your partner along
Raise a 4-star wanted level
Break line of sight and wait out the search
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level in the same moment. Partner missions end late in the story, so do this while partner missions are still available.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping — keep the partner close, move fast between shops, and do not let the cops catch up between robberies.
steps: Pick three shops close together
Rob them back-to-back with your partner
Keep the wanted level alive through all three
trophies.missableNote: Back-to-back means no gap: the wanted level must survive all three robberies. Partner availability ends late in the story — do it early.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts — the tracker logs it the first time you get in. Just drive everything you see: parked cars, boats, bikes and aircraft all add to the count.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you see
Check car parks, marinas and airfields for new types

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out. Gang hideouts are the reliable spot — five enemies in one room.
steps: Find five enemies grouped together
Trigger Combat Focus and chain five takedowns

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a plane from the airport and take off without a flight plan — the runway is the trigger. Expect an immediate wanted level, so climb fast and head for the coast.
steps: Get to a plane at VCIA
Take off without a flight plan
trophies.missableNote: A one-time airport stunt: the departure only counts when it is unscheduled. Airport security ramps up after story events, so do it while VCIA is still lightly guarded.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos — the trophy is about time in the tank, so keep moving and use the cannon on anything that shoots back. Tanks appear at the military base and in late-story missions.
steps: Find a Rhino tank at the military base or in a late mission
Stay in the tank and keep the cannon firing

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. Case the store first, enter after closing or through the back, and leave before the alarm trips.
steps: Case the store and plan the entry
Rob it without tripping an alarm or being seen
trophies.missableNote: One clean run is all it takes — but if you are spotted, the attempt fails and the store's security changes. Save before you go in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults are the big heists — each one is a planned job, so expect a full wanted level on the way out. Five vaults, five clean getaways; keep a fast car stashed nearby for each one.
steps: Plan each vault job
Escape cleanly after each vault

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Trucks run set routes — block one, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the escort responds. A sticky bomb on the rear door is the classic opener.
steps: Block an armored truck on its route
Crack it open and escape before the escort responds

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — every region, island and back road counts. Drive the coastline, fly over the interior, and check the map for the last grey patches.
steps: Drive the coastline and every region
Fly over the interior for the last grey patches

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs off-the-books operations — hit one per gang. The operations are marked once you discover them; the last gang's is the hardest to find, so sweep the industrial districts.
steps: Discover the illegal operations
Rob one operation per gang

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet story moment — sit at the beach bar, order the cocktail and watch the scene play out. It only happens once, at the point in the story when the game offers it.
steps: Reach the Ocean Beach scene in the story
Take the cocktail prompt when it appears
trophies.missableNote: A one-time story scene on Ocean Beach. Take the prompt when it appears; after the scene passes, the moment is gone.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom glass — the trophy is the exit, not the entrance. Pick a showroom with a clear road outside for the getaway.
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom
Smash out through the glass and keep driving
trophies.missableNote: A one-time set-piece exit. Once the showroom is smashed, that scene is done — make the exit count the first time.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the alley — follow-through means finishing all ten frames. Bowling is a timing mini-game: release on the beat and aim for the pocket.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play all ten frames

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build your partnership's reputation — joint activities, shared wins and public appearances all feed it. Keep doing things together and the trophy pops when the partnership's appeal peaks.
steps: Do joint activities with your partner
Keep building the partnership's appeal

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Some story moments offer a choice, and this trophy is about the one you pick. There is no wrong answer for the story, but the trophy tracks the choice — save before the big decisions so you can see both outcomes.
steps: Save in a separate slot before the decision scene
Make the choice
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a story choice. Save in a separate slot before the decision scene; the choice locks once made.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Something goes wrong the first time — and the trophy is for the retry. When a story event fails on the first attempt, go straight back in and finish it on the second.
steps: Let the story event fail the first time
Retry it immediately and finish it
trophies.missableNote: The trophy is the second attempt itself. If the first attempt succeeds cleanly, the setup is gone — keep a save before the event.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? An easter-egg encounter — a strange sighting in the wilds of Leonida. It triggers at a specific place and time, so check the source for the location and go at night.
steps: Check the source for the sighting location
Go there at night and watch for it
trophies.missableNote: A one-time sighting. If you scare it off or miss the window, the encounter may not repeat — save before you go.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past the bowling alley's pins — or a set of standing targets — and knock them down with a melee swing from the vehicle. Line up the approach and swing as you pass.
steps: Line up a drive-by approach
Swing the melee weapon as you pass the pins

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists; your contacts wash them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs — $250,000 is the lifetime figure, not one job.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists
Launder them through your contacts after every score

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cars, clothes, weapons and property all count — the total is lifetime spending, so it ticks up as you play. If you are close, buy a high-end car to close the gap.
steps: Spend as you play — cars, clothes, weapons
Buy a high-end car to close the last gap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are bought from the in-game property sites — each one costs money, so save up and buy them as they appear. The last garage is the most expensive, so keep a cash reserve.
steps: Check the property sites for garages
Buy each garage as it appears

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or scan vehicles with the app — each new registration counts. Ten different vehicles, any kind; the app marks which ones you have already registered.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register 10 different vehicles
